svg.title: Technical toolkit
svg.desc: Nine groups of tools. Generative AI and LLM systems: Hugging Face, prompt design, embeddings, retrieval-grounded answers. Agentic AI and tool orchestration: tool-calling chains, policy gates, retries with backoff, human escalation, audit logging, concurrent execution. RAG, semantic search and vector databases: Qdrant, ChromaDB, BM25, reciprocal rank fusion, cross-encoder reranking, Sentence-Transformers. Machine learning and NLP: PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV, BERT, BiLSTM with attention, SHAP, NLTK, TF-IDF. Data engineering and analytics: pandas, NumPy, SciPy, SQLite, Parquet, Jupyter, ETL scripts, deduplication, EDA, feature engineering. Python, SQL and languages: Python, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Java, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3. Backend APIs and databases: FastAPI, Flask, Pydantic, Supabase, JWT, REST, server-sent events, role-based access. Visualization, geospatial and interfaces: Streamlit, Plotly, React, Vite, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, choropleth GIS maps, Matplotlib, Seaborn. Cloud, testing and DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, Git, GitHub, pytest, AWS, Nginx, Docker Compose, structured logging.
